tasks.description: Read-only acceptance of the narrow authenticated permanent test-account photo-to-diagnosis server path. Inspect current implementation and fixture evidence.
constraints: Explicit full snapshot audit of this narrow backend slice. Controller materialized the candidate, use checks-first, no Developer/implementation changes. Existing auth, collection wire and accepted quota logic must remain intact. Prior engine prepare/summary merged 8b2c637. No CI, iOS, deployment, secrets, live account changes or actual provider calls by model roles.

Production private photo ticket owns its asset and operation receipt. Verify 60-second application signature and DB expiry, bearer owner, bounded image format/size/SHA256, private bucket and no upsert, retry/complete after lost response, wrong-owner refusal. SQL checks use a Storage metadata fixture and SDK transport fixture, not deployed Storage.

One active permanent owner. Fresh job creation, quota admission and receipt atomic. Replays precede availability/quota. Owner-scoped reads and expiry release via status/new create. A single target lease and budget start, stale lease cannot finalize. Worker downloads verified stored bytes, uses pinned published catalogue/KB, real production Anthropic SDK entrypoint and explicit no-sampling Haiku5.5 body. Provider responses in local tests are mocks.

Preserve provider failure/no-quota semantics and accepted quota/existing HTTP gates. Status only exposes the matching validated projection. EN/PL display names come from pinned data. One staging Monstera profile validated, with three independent factual sources and no calendar interval. Artifact not applied to staging; no deployment, provider, live Storage or full T031/T033/T034 completion claim. Installation, guest transfer, saving diagnosis, background expiry maintenance outside this slice.

Independent Astra Reviewer and QA. Judge actual configured checks/evidence and source, not an empty patch. No changes to tests/gates/config or handling of credentials. Staging auth/profiles were checked separately, missing Anthropic secret and staging migration/KB prerequisites are documented in handoff.

acceptance_criteria.description: Private upload and owner-scoped production API-to-worker fixture. Replays, refusal, invalid image, missing provider and label/KB scope.
Real clean/upgrade PostgreSQL fixture gate for owner isolation, upload receipts, atomic reservation, lease/budget, immutable settlement and quota regressions.
Actual API/worker entrypoints typecheck and source diff check.
